summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes 727 KB obfuscated Bun payload
details: package.json sets `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (or reuses a local `bun` binary), extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the bundled `math_init.js` — a 727 KB single-line obfuscated `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a rotated string/number table (`WV8StW` shift-rotator over `n7gIxM`) and mangled identifiers. The payload is executed automatically on `npm install` under an alternate language runtime, so Node-based install-time inspection never observes its behavior. The package advertises itself as a TSLint folder-schema rule (main `lib/folderSchemaRule.js`, homepage `github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint`), a purpose that has no functional need for a bundled Bun runtime or a 727 KB obfuscated bundle — the shipped contents do not match the advertised purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
